The organ that pumps blood is the heart.

Accessibility Audit:
The provided text describes a public transportation website that presents real-time schedules in a graphical format without accompanying text descriptions. This design choice creates a significant accessibility barrier for individuals using screen readers, as the visual information cannot be conveyed to them. To improve accessibility, the website should provide text-based alternatives, such as alt text for images or a fully accessible text-based schedule, ensuring compliance with inclusive design standards and making the information available to all users, including those with visual impairments.
